name: zopt_evaluate_profile_metric_condition
description: zOpt::EvaluateProfileMetricCondition accepts DEFAULT string rules and evaluates array metric conditions against the runtime options profile.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the repeated inlined strcmp checks use sbb flag sequences that the current LLIL lifter does not fully model. The smoke verifies DEFAULT handling, rejected node/count forms, all recovered metric keys, and unknown metric fallback.
